en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. Abi (rah) from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Muhammad b. al-Hussain from Abdulrahman b. Abi Hashim al-Bazaz al-Asadi from Dawud b. Farqad from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who claims to be an Imam while he is not, has associated lie with Allah, His Messenger and me.”
